regenerate: Deploy patches/target_c_volume_{window,arm,hold}.sh and battery_server.sh to the box (patches/README.md), then run patches/target_c_volume_mac.sh with OUT set to a new directory and OFFSET=200, and arm a window. Run indices seed the datasets and the sampling, but the server's batching varies, so a rerun writes different loops. A top-up continues past next_run_ix with --resume on this directory.
